'''''The Truce at Bakura''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Kathy Tyers]]. It was the fourth novel published by [[Bantam Spectra]], following ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]'', and it was first printed in hardcover in [[November]] [[1993]]. The novel is set in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], shortly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].
